'''Poliss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] shopkeeper on board the [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|Bazaar]] specializing in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sales and repair. Poliss was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and often recruited new members with the help of the craftsman, [[Jerru]]. He was the point of contact used by [[Hanos Darr]] and [[Zaz Kamiroz]] when they needed to relay information regarding the discovery of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] to the Alliance.
